svg.title: ci-build kernel pipeline — illustrative run
svg.desc: An illustrative ci-build run. Three targets — garnet-gki (5.10 GKI), lavender-4.4 and lavender-4.19 — move through the stages resolve, patch, toolchain, compile, AnyKernel3 and release, each turning green when complete, ending with a kernel image and an AnyKernel3 zip per variant.
